Say hello to Mayra Pacheco, our new Operations Manager.

Mayra joins Custom Goods Logistics with more than 20 years across account management, logistics, and supply chain and a reputation for the thing that actually keeps freight moving: being the person both customers and internal teams trust to solve the hard problems.
